headlines.headline: Reliance Q2 results: Net profit jumps 41% YoY to ₹25,548 crore; O2C revenues surge 44% on higher energy prices

headlines.headline: Reliance Q2 results: Net profit likely to see up to 20% YoY growth driven by recovery in O2C business and strong refining margins
